job.purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed hbm_stn_stn_r36_30f87bcc4 (hfd_stn_r36, RTL 30f87bcc4, snapshot of 2 drifted files): same RTL, outline 39.288x77.736, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Claude:hbm-views

benches.name: exact_station
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/hfd_stn_r36_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/hfd_stn_r36_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { bash physical/hbm_accel_die_views/stations/bench/run_bench.sh $PWD/physical/hbm_accel_die_views/stations hfd_stn_r36 $PWD {RUN}/bench; cat {RUN}/bench/hfd_stn_r36/result.txt; grep -q '^pos rc=0' {RUN}/bench/hfd_stn_r36/result.txt
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the 30f87bcc4 snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/hfd_stn_r36_m5/src]

benches.name: neg_mutant
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_1; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/hfd_stn_r36_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/hfd_stn_r36_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { grep -q '^neg rc=1' {RUN}/bench/hfd_stn_r36/result.txt && echo STN_NEG_DETECTED && exit 1; exit 0
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the 30f87bcc4 snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/hfd_stn_r36_m5/src]
